messages:
sam.k: Need an overnight quota top-up for staging (apac). We're running an AMI bake + nightly perf runs and are running low on GPU credits/slots. Can we get a temporary +200 GPU-hours for tonight? Terraform apply is blocked by state-lock so will need coordination.

maria: which region exactly? we might have spare slots in us-west but apac is tight right now.

sam.k: apac-east1 — bakes need to run close to the staging network. each AMI bake uses a single A100 for ~4h; we have ~30 images queued so ~120 GPU-hours. asking +200 to be safe for retries.

leo: ok. sku is A100 right? I can open a vendor ticket. if we can't get apac, we'll fallback to us-west canary.

sam.k: yep A100. fallback will degrade latency for tests so prefer apac.

tara: looping in procurement/finance — @ashley any objections to a one-off topup charged to sprint budget?

ashley: small one-off is fine. please add an estimate and ticket number here for records.

vendor_ops_bot: Ticket created VND-4821. Vendor ETA for quota change: 2-3 hours. Contact: apac-ops@vendor.com

maria: heads-up — terraform state-lock is blocking the infra change. once vendor confirms quota, someone will need to `terraform force-unlock <LOCK_ID>` then update vars. Suggest PR to bump `staging_gpu_hours`.

sam.k: filing PR now and will ping for LGTM. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4223

leo: I'll prepare a us-west canary plan in case ETA slips >3h. otherwise we'll wait for vendor.

vendor_ops_bot: Update on VND-4821 — quota increased to 600 GPU-hours in apac-east1. Confirmed by ops@vendor.com

sam.k: Nice — unlocked state and applied infra changes, AMI bakes scheduled. Thanks everyone :rocket:
